The MRI results showing atrophy and signal changes in the brainstem, cerebellum, and basal ganglia, combined with your symptoms of gait instability, urinary incontinence, and speech difficulties, strongly point to Multiple System Atrophy. This is a rare neurodegenerative disorder characterized by the progressive loss of nerve cells in specific parts of the brain.
